name: Effective Range / Proper Unlabeled Sample Compression
details: False for finite classes under the message-free definition: #classes/balanced_six_split has E=10 but pUSC $+\infty$. Its shattered coordinate pairs force incompatible proper decoder assignments already on empty and singleton keys. No stability assumption or bound on larger keys is used. If a proper unlabeled scheme exists, its size can be bounded by E by discarding constant coordinates; the obstruction is nonexistence.
proof_source: Survey Corollary cor:balanced-six-split-nonexistence and Proposition prop:proper-unlabeled-pair-obstruction.
witness_verification: Values 1181 and 1184 give E=10 and pUSC $+\infty$. Nonexistence on a fixed finite class refutes every finite upper bound; this is not an asymptotic-family claim.
witness_review: The previous singletons-plus-empty example remains a valid gap in the opposite direction, not a counterexample to the stated inequality. The six-split class now witnesses its refutation.
